verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is Zap workflows that execute triggered actions unattended. Docs reference Zap workflows, polling and webhook triggers, and running automations. Hands-on community reports describe Zaps executing on their own, such as a calendar-sync Zap that fired on a Sunday morning, and Zap executions being counted per month. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of background/scheduled execution (schedule triggers, run history, autonomy controls) and stronger independent corroboration of agents running autonomously rather than on prompt.
